sections.heading: Audit verdict

10 pass, 3 watch and 3 flag across the 17 tests.

rows: Mean CFO / net profit 49% over 5 years
3 FLAG / 3 WATCH across 16 accounting tests; LojikX™ Consistency Score 57/100

sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: CFO vs. Net Income Conversion: Operating cash flow converted 49% of reported net profit. Profit is running ahead of cash generation, which points to working-capital or accrual quality issues.
FCF Generation Consistency: Free cash flow was positive in 2 of the last 5 reported years. Repeated FCF deficits mean growth is being funded by the balance sheet rather than by the business.
Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 6.8 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 6.8 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Working Capital Cycle (DSO / DIO): The cash conversion cycle absorbs 141 days of working capital. A long cycle ties up cash and makes growth expensive to fund.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 32 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 3 hard red flags and 3 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 57/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
